name: Great Taming
momentumNotes: Great energy is being held and cultivated; restraint increases future usefulness.
theme: Great Taming stores immense force within the mountain. Power becomes fruitful when it is cultivated rather than spent too soon.
basicInterpretation: Hold your energy with purpose. Study, prepare, and strengthen the vessel so that action later can be clean and effective.
reflectionPrompt: What power needs cultivation before release?

reversed.theme: Flipped upside down, Great Taming becomes Hexagram 25, Innocence. This other side brings in the atmosphere of sincerity, naturalness, integrity, asking how the situation may look from another threshold.
reversed.reflection: Let Innocence widen the reading rather than replace it. Consider what another person, timing, or hidden part of you might see when the pattern is viewed from the far side.
reversed.applicationPrompt: Visualize your question from the far side, as if another person or your future self is looking back through Innocence. Notice where sincerity, naturalness, integrity and a moving, unforced movement reveal needs, timing, or motives that the first view may miss.

opposite.theme: The contrast to Great Taming is Hexagram 45, Gathering Together. Where the primary pattern emphasizes restraint, stored power, cultivation, this complementary field points toward assembly, community, focus.
opposite.reflection: This is not the main movement of the reading, but it shows what balances or challenges it. It can also highlight hidden causes or contrasting forces at play. Notice where Gathering Together names the medicine, shadow, or unchosen path beside the situation.
opposite.applicationPrompt: Visualize Gathering Together as the contrasting color laid beside Great Taming. Ask what hidden cause, missing medicine, or opposing pressure is suggested by assembly, community, focus, especially where the situation carries a communal, supportive tone.
